author: clay391
quote: GTA 6 is such a huge disappointment, and the story is so slow that you spend the beginning fixing up Jason's house and dealing with relationship crap instead of doing awesome crimes. Jason is boring compared to Trevor or Niko, and half the time he feels more like Lucia's personal servant than an actual GTA criminal. Instead of letting us be crazy criminals, the developers seem more interested in making us play their perfect little love story where Jason buys Lucia groceries, flowers, and gifts to keep her happy. It feels like the developers are forcing their own idea of a perfect relationship into a game that's supposed to be about stealing cars and causing chaos. We waited 13 years for GTA 6, and somehow they made a game where being a good boyfriend seems more important than being a gangster. DON'T BUY PEOPLE!
